title: Electricity Security is Replacing Fuel Security as the Core Energy‐Security Challenge—Part 1
content: The next era of energy security will be won by the countries that can build, connect, finance, regulate, and defend the world's most reliable power systems. Winners will demonstrate greater resilience, economic competitiveness, strategic autonomy, or geopolitical influence.
author: Thomas N. Russo
